raw_finding.actual_implementation: Single unified `private-branch.{branchId}` channel — all surfaces (KDS, POS, OSS, kiosk, stock-rupture-dashboard) subscribe and filter client-side by `broadcastAs` event-name opt-in

agent_positions.C6_sync_agent: Surfaced as C6-ARCH-001 INFO (architectural mismatch in task spec wording, not a code-side defect). Cross-pollution prevented at PER-EVENT-NAME OPT-IN layer + branch_id isolation in routes/channels.php authz callback.
agent_positions.B3_1_architect: Confirmed C6-ARCH-001 conclusion via cross_reference field: 'channel topology is correct, cross-pollution prevented at event-name layer, NOT a finding to track.' INFO B3-ARCH-007 also confirms Outbox + DispatchableAfterCommit + single private-branch channel as the V1 SSOT working as designed.
agent_positions.B3_2_security: No Echo channel security issue. routes/channels.php:44-50 kiosk token-name check (R3 T-3.2.2 F-SEC-W6-01 heal) + routes/channels.php:56-58 Admin/Tenant Admin role check (F-SEC-W6-02 heal) close the Guest-Echo-Bypass latent path. Branch isolation enforced at authorization layer.

conflicts_arbitrated.n2_verdict_rationale: Three independent agents (C6, B3.1, B3.2) converged on the same conclusion: single unified `private-branch.{branchId}` channel + per-event-name listener opt-in is the intentional V1 SSOT. Adding per-surface channels would require N×branches=N more Broadcast::channel() authz callbacks for ZERO behavioral gain. Cross-pollution is structurally impossible: (a) authz callback enforces branch_id isolation, (b) each component invokes onEvents() with explicit broadcastAs filter so KDS never executes a CatalogChanged handler, (c) DispatchableAfterCommit ensures events fire after DB commit. NO V1 ACTION REQUIRED. Future GOAL specs MUST align their channel-naming language to the actual SSOT.
conflicts_arbitrated.follow_through_in_round_2: Update internal task-spec templates to use `private-branch.{branchId}` consistently. Tracked as C6-DEBT-001 INFO documentation-only.

conflicts_arbitrated.title: Login password policy — min:6 vs EmployeeRequest min:12 divergence

raw_finding.B3_2_finding: B3.2-002 P1: LoginController.php:49 validator `'password' => ['required', 'string', 'min:6']` vs EmployeeRequest.php:47-50 `Password::min(12)->letters()->numbers()`. Legacy weak passwords bypass modern bar.

heal_applied.title: fix(goal-heal-sec-002): login password validation parity — drop min:N
heal_applied.patch_summary: Per OWASP guidance: drop password min-length validation entirely on LOGIN endpoints. Login is a credential CHECK, not a credential CREATE — enforcing min-length on login wrongly rejects legitimate users with legacy short passwords AND leaks which passwords don't meet the policy. EmployeeRequest still enforces min:12 + letters + numbers on CREATION. Migration to stronger passwords happens via password-rotation flow, not login-side validation.

agent_positions.B3_2_security: P1 finding logged with detailed exploit path. Originally recommended bumping min to 8 or 12 + adding rehash hook for force-reset. Heal applied via OWASP-compliant alternative (drop validation, not bump).
agent_positions.B3_5_tester: No dedicated login-min-length sentinel — sentinel coverage for the heal would be a V1.0.2 backlog addition.
agent_positions.B3_4_sre: Login throttle 10/10min identity-keyed + 30/min kiosk-login limiter (RouteServiceProvider.php:224-243). IP-only secondary limiter not present — flagged as B3.2-006 P3 separately.

conflicts_arbitrated.n2_verdict_rationale: OWASP guidance is correct and the heal is OWASP-compliant: LOGIN endpoints should NOT enforce password complexity. Complexity belongs to CREATION endpoints (EmployeeRequest still enforces min:12 + letters + numbers). Dropping min:N on login closes the divergence by eliminating the weaker constraint, not by tightening it. Legacy users with short passwords can still authenticate (their bcrypt hash is checked against the right credential); password rotation happens via separate flow. NO V1 ACTION REQUIRED.
conflicts_arbitrated.owner_action_required: NONE for V1 ship. V1.0.2 backlog: add sentinel locking the dropped-min-N rule + Password::uncompromised() HIBP integration on creation endpoints + force-rotation hook for legacy short-password accounts (B3.2-002 fix_recommended layer 2).
conflicts_arbitrated.follow_through_in_round_2: Verify LoginController.php:49 source after heal — no min:N constraint should remain. Sentinel `loginPasswordPolicySentinel.spec.js` recommended as V1.0.2 add.
